slides.1.content: 4+4+7+3+8+7 = 33. Central Greece (incl. Attica) and Thrace have no PDOs and rely on PGIs. The list follows the official map; Level 3 shows how to check it against the current official list.
slides.2.title: The north and interior
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Macedonia
slides.2.highlights.0.content: Home of Xinomavro; cooler and higher; Naoussa is the core, Amyndeo cooler still
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Thessaly
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Epirus
slides.2.content: Common tags for the north: cool, inland, red (Xinomavro)-led.
slides.3.title: The south and islands
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Peloponnese
slides.3.highlights.1.title: Aegean islands
slides.3.highlights.1.content: Santorini (Assyrtiko), Samos (Muscat), Lemnos (Limnio, Muscat), Rhodes, Paros
slides.3.highlights.2.title: Crete
slides.3.highlights.2.content: Vidiano, Kotsifali, Mandilaria; Peza, Archanes, Sitia and Malvasia sweet wines
slides.3.highlights.3.title: Ionian Islands
slides.3.content: Common tags for the south and islands: sun, wind and sweet-wine traditions (Muscat, Malvasia, Mavrodaphne).
slides.4.title: Regions without PDOs, and PGIs
slides.4.highlights.0.title: Central Greece and Attica
slides.4.highlights.0.content: Mainly PGIs and Traditional terms such as Retsina; Savatiano is the workhorse
slides.4.highlights.1.title: Thrace
slides.4.highlights.2.title: 114 PGIs
slides.4.highlights.2.content: PGIs far outnumber PDOs, with wider areas and more flexible rules (see Level 2)
slides.4.content: "No PDO" does not mean lower quality; it reflects a choice in naming systems.
slides.5.componentProps.slide.title: 🧠 Knowledge Check
Which area has no PDOs and relies on PGIs and Traditional terms?
Central Greece (incl. Attica) and Thrace have no PDOs.
Which geographic zone has the most PDOs?
The Aegean islands have 8 PDOs, the most of any zone.
